title: Add an update-available prompt so the PWA updates in place without losing data

subtasks.title: Add update-available reload prompt
subtasks.goal: Switch the PWA to a controlled prompt-to-reload update flow so users apply new deploys in place, with local data preserved.
subtasks.seam: vite.config.ts: VitePWA registerType 'autoUpdate' -> 'prompt' (keep strategies:'injectManifest', srcDir:'src', filename:'sw.ts'). src/sw.ts: remove top-level `await self.skipWaiting()`; keep clientsClaim(); in the existing `message` listener add a branch `if (event.data?.type === 'SKIP_WAITING') self.skipWaiting()`. New src/components/UpdatePrompt.tsx: uses `useRegisterSW` from 'virtual:pwa-register/react'; when `needRefresh` is true renders a toast 'New version available' with a Reload button calling `updateServiceWorker(true)`. Wire <UpdatePrompt/> into src/App.tsx. No changes to localStorage/IndexedDB stores.
